bb_288_8_20_24x6.construction: Bivariate bicycle code on Z_24 x Z_6: A = y + x^3 + x^4, B = y^3 + x + x^8. Found by an evolutionary search over BB polynomials. Bilayer layout (max check diameter 6.708) found by simulated annealing from a folded-torus start.
bb_288_8_20_24x6.status_reason: distance 20 is an upper bound only; exact proof pending (see results/proofs)

bb_288_12_16_24x6.construction: Bivariate bicycle code on Z_24 x Z_6: A = y^3 + x + x^14, B = y + y^2 + x^3. Found by an evolutionary search over BB polynomials. Distance d <= 16 by witness; our own integer program (HiGHS MILP) found no lighter logical, which is not a board certificate (see the research note). Bilayer layout (max check diameter 7.000) found by simulated annealing from a folded-torus start.
bb_288_12_16_24x6.provenance_notes: Checked, not equivalent: verify/validate_candidate.py's dedup (exact fingerprint and WL signature) matched no board entry.

bb_144_8_12_12x6.construction: Bivariate bicycle code on Z_12 x Z_6: A = y + x^3 + x^10, B = y^3 + x + x^2. Found by an evolutionary search over BB polynomials. Bilayer layout (max check diameter 6.708) found by simulated annealing from a folded-torus start.
bb_144_8_12_12x6.status_reason: non-dominated in 2D-local bilayer weight-6 (board of 28 Sep); d = 12 proven by MILP and DistQLDPC. Displaced once anyone lays out the gross code within the bilayer cap. Dominated by the gross-code bilayer layout (PR #2394) once that merges.

ibm_gross_144_12_12.status_reason: IBM's code; the layout alone is not a contribution worth a record

bb_144_12_12_gross_bilayer.construction: The gross code of Bravyi, Cross, Gambetta, Maslov, Rall and Yoder (arXiv:2308.07915), written on Z_12 x Z_6 as A = y + y^2 + x^3, B = y^3 + x^2 + x^7 (a relabelling of their A = x^3 + y + y^2, B = y^3 + x + x^2). New here: a bilayer layout (max check diameter 6.708) found by simulated annealing from a folded-torus start.
bb_144_12_12_gross_bilayer.provenance_notes: Equivalent to the board's 144-12-12.json (IBM's gross code, arXiv:2308.07915): same spectral fingerprint and WL signature. The code is theirs; this entry contributes only the bilayer layout within the 7.0 cap, which the board did not have. Parameters are known (novelty: known_parameters).
bb_144_12_12_gross_bilayer.status_reason: user approved 2026-09-30: IBM's gross code, credited, submitted for its bilayer layout; displaces our [[144,8,12]] (#2337)

tile_288_8_15_a637.construction: Tile code (Steffan, Choe, Breuckmann, Pereira, Eberhardt, arXiv:2504.09171) with box B = 3 on a 10 x 10 bulk, open boundaries as in the paper; X-tile {h00,h01,h11,h22,v02,v10,v20,v21}, Z-tile by their condition T2. Tile found by our exhaustive screen of 3 x 3 weight-8 tiles for the single-layer cell. Single-layer layout: each edge on its own integer site of the 45-degree rotated lattice, interaction radius 4.000.
tile_288_8_15_a637.status_reason: tile hunt 2026-10-01: non-dominated in 2D-local single weight-8; d exact by DistQLDPC (rule 1, tile codes)
